question: What guaranteed revenue does Governor General earn before Govern checks? Explain unrest from sixes, failure and tax, options per region and success limit.
rationale: Q044 expressly selects guaranteed pre-check revenue, unrest from sixes/failure/tax, regional options and the success limit. The failure clause asks what unrest an unsuccessful check creates; it does not ask whether the Governor General can attempt another check. The success-limit clause limits successful Govern actions, not the number or permissibility of failed attempts. At most one successful Govern answers that clause fully. Resource-sufficient noncatastrophic retry permission is shared success-check procedure, explicitly requested by Q007, so it is contextual in Q044. Preserve all unrest triggers, distinct tax-region condition, regional options and the one-success cap. A materially false volunteered retry/attempt restriction remains a contradiction; no wrong-rule test is weakened.

wrong_rule_boundary: Omitting generic retry permission is acceptable in Q044. Affirmatively forbidding all retries after a noncatastrophic failure remains a material wrong rule. Allowing more than one successful Govern still contradicts the expressly requested success limit. All asked unrest triggers and tax-region conditions remain mandatory.
